brief: The content strategy that took a B2B brand from 0 to 1M views/year.

slots.headline: How we turned content into one million views
slots.swipeNote: Swipe to see the 6 steps we used

slots.title: Audit before you create
slots.body: We mapped every existing asset against search intent and buyer pain points. Most B2B brands skip this and wonder why reach stalls.

slots.title: Own one niche first
slots.body: Broad thought leadership sounds impressive but earns crickets. We picked a single vertical and owned its conversation for six months.

slots.title: Build repeatable formats
slots.body: Random posts burn teams out. We designed three recurring series that readers recognized instantly, cutting production time by half.

slots.title: Distribute like a publisher
slots.body: One great post is worthless if nobody sees it. We built a channel playbook that pushed every story to four owned platforms.

slots.title: Activate your insiders
slots.body: Your team is your largest untapped audience. We armed executives and sales with hook-first copy they could share in one click.

slots.title: Close the feedback loop
slots.body: Views are vanity if they don’t drive pipeline. We tracked engaged reading time and used it to refine the next month’s calendar.

slots.quote: Build the system, then scale the story
slots.headline: Start building your content engine
slots.author: Maya Chen
